improvements: All three participation features require the same complete 4–12 prior comparable observations. Missing inputs and zero-variance baselines withhold the grade; no partial-feature renormalization.
Every grade retains current and all prior bidder amounts, denominator, BTC, identity, dates, mean, population standard deviation, rounded standardized contributions, fixed weights and grade formula.

Bidder percentages require all three nonnegative accepted categories. Their explicit denominator is their sum, never a fallback to gross issuance; reported competitive and gross totals remain separate.
Both existing native acquisition paths retain missing-BTC rows. Same-day auctions cannot shorten the strictly-earlier trailing comparison cohort.

Complete non-bill grade populations are required for day classifications. Unknown instruments, missing/empty grades and invalid buyback fill inputs withhold the selected historical cohort. Bills-only uses structured security identity.
Day descriptions preserve unknown totals and separate accepted buyback par from monetary effects. Existing consumer fields remain and price-lineage/forecast permissions stay false.
The page requires the new grade contract, exposes full escaped inputs in a bounded keyboard-scrollable disclosure and labels the latest-200 packet / 80-row displayed sample.
Keyboard QA found and repaired focus escaping behind the grade dialog and missing focus restoration. Mobile calculation rows stack with explicit labels and no horizontal overflow.

synthetic_capacity.scope: Local synthetic actual reviewed analyzer only, not native full-handler capacity proof

limitations: All ten platform workstreams remain open. Descriptive grades do not establish predictive skill or supported portfolio sizing.
The existing normalized bank is current-vintage; completeness of historical acquisition, original provider flags and historical first-publication availability remain unverified.
The legacy public latest-200 sample remains bounded and explicitly labeled; all rows are retained in the source bank and incomplete rows no longer disappear from analysis.

Duplicate price dates can still fabricate a forward observed-bar return in the inherited reaction calculation. That separately reproduced defect is next; price displays remain withheld under the existing lineage gate.
Local analyzer capacity on 22,470 synthetic rows used 539,221,737 traced bytes and 52.412 seconds with tracing enabled. This is not native whole-handler capacity proof; resources remain unchanged.
Code/package/static acceptance and ordinary producer publication are separate. No ad-hoc invocation or accelerated publication is authorized.
